alt_text: Davos Life Science & ColorNet Partnership: Transforming Brazil’s Skincare Future with the Power of Tocotrienols
caption:
Davos Life Science Sdn. Bhd. as part of KLK OLEO Group, a global leader in natural palm-derived Tocotrienols, and ColorNet, a leading distributor serving Brazil’s beauty and personal care industry, are pleased to announce a strategic partnership to expand the availability of DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols in the Brazilian skincare market.
The partnership marks an important milestone for both organisations as ColorNet becomes Davos Life Science’s authorised distributor for the personal care segment in Brazil. Through this collaboration, both companies aim to introduce scientifically backed Tocotrienols solutions to cosmetic manufacturers and brand owners seeking innovative ingredients for skin health and beauty applications.
 
Reveal Natural Radiance. Restore Youthful Luminosity.
DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols — the “Extraordinary Super Vitamin E” — act on skin through three complementary mechanisms: potent antioxidant activity, powerful anti-inflammatory action, and gene modulation. This triple mode of action is documented across an extensive body of peer-reviewed research covering anti-ageing, skin brightening, blue light and pollution defence, and skin barrier support.
 
Clinically demonstrated in human studies

Reduces UV-induced skin redness by up to 26%
Reduces UV-induced tanning by up to 32%

 
Science Proven Multi-Pathway Benefits from published studies



Combats Oxidative stress — reduces DNA, lipid and protein oxidation markers: 8-OHdG by up to 66%, malondialdehyde by 44%, and protein carbonyl by 58%.
Benefits: Helps protect skin from premature ageing, and promotes healthier, more resilient skin.
Inflammatory response Calms Inflammation & Skin Irritation — downregulates key mediators: IL-6 by up to 64%, IL-8 by 72%, and COX-2 by 47%.
Benefits: Helps soothe redness and sensitivity, supports faster skin recovery, improves overall skin comfort.
Reduces Hyperpigmentation, Brightens Skin Tone Pigmentation — suppresses tyrosinase expression, reducing melanin production by up to 55%.
Benefits: Helps minimise dark spots and uneven pigmentation, promotes brighter and more radiant skin, and supports a more uniform skin tone.
Defends Against Pollution-Induced Skin Damage Pollution defence and barrier integrity — suppresses PM2.5-induced MAPK signalling, downregulating phosphorylation of p38 by 61%, JNK1/2 by 70% and ERK by 24%. Also protects cells from mitochondria-mediated apoptosis. Under the same conditions, alpha-tocopherol showed no strong inhibitory effect.
Benefits: Strengthens the skin barrier against urban pollution, helps prevent environmental ageing, enhances skin resilience, reduces visible signs of stress caused by external aggressors, and supports long-term skin vitality.



Learn more about the full skincare benefits of DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols.
 
Key Consumer Takeaway
Tocotrienols deliver clinically proven protection against the four major drivers of skin ageing: oxidative stress, inflammation, hyperpigmentation, and environmental pollution, resulting in healthier, brighter, younger-looking, and more resilient skin.
 
Sustainably Sourced. Fully Traceable.
DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols are sourced from sustainably managed palm plantations within the Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”) Group, the parent company of Davos Life Science, ensuring full supply chain traceability, consistent batch-to-batch quality, and reliable long-term supply security.
Davos Life Science, a subsidiary of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK), a leading diversified resource-based manufacturing and international plantation group, is a global producer of high-quality natural phytonutrients. caption:
Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”), one of the leading plantation companies in Malaysia announces its sponsorship of World rank No 7 Badminton Mixed Doubles, Chan Peng Soon and Goh Liu Ying.
The sponsorship, in line with its corporate responsibility effort to promote harmonious culture through sports as well as to support our nation’s pursuit for global sports excellence, it is hoped that the Rio silver medallists duo will continue to bring all Malaysians together and make the country proud when chasing their Tokyo Olympics dream.
KLK executive director Lee Jia Zhang said in a statement that, “We understand that the COVID-19 pandemic has changed many of our lives, we are humbled to be able to help ease the financial woes for our Malaysian Mixed Doubles during this difficult period. We hope that with our sponsorship, Peng Soon-Liu Ying can focus and be better prepared for the Games.”
The Tokyo Olympics was deferred for one-year to July 23 – Aug 8 in 2021 due to the pandemic. Although Peng Soon-Liu Ying had forgo the two Denmark Opens in October 2020, they are looking at making a return early next year for the two BWF Opens in Asia. The world No. 7 duo need to stay within the top 16 until next year to qualify for Tokyo Olympics 2021.
Chan Peng Soon has expressed his gratitude to KLK for the support given to Goh Liu Ying and him. “The deferment of this year’s Olympics also meant that we will need to continue to train to maintain our physical form for another 12 months, in which this will require extra financial expenses. Thank you KLK for coming forward to support us during this difficult time as it is not easy to find support and sponsorship during the COVID-19 pandemic”, said Chan.
“The money will help us cover the travel expenses for our future tournaments. We can now focus on qualifying for the Tokyo Olympics and hopefully achieve a better result for Malaysia”, said Liu Ying.
Since turning Pro as independent players, Peng Soon-Liu Ying have done well by winning the 2019 Thailand Masters and New Zealand Open.
The announcement also sees Peng Soon-Liu Ying become the first brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement comprising Tocotrienols and alpha tocopherol derived from palm fruits. It is formulated for high bio-absorption and suitable for adults with busy lifestyle and elderly with symptoms of tiredness. Tocotrienols as an antioxidant is beneficial at neutralizing free radicals and may help support overall wellness and vitality and boost healthier body.
(From left) Jimmy Yow, Head of Sales and Marketing of KLK OLEO, Goh Liu Ying, Eric Tan, Senior Manager, Sales and Marketing of KLK Land, Chan Peng Soon and Lee Jia Zhang, Executive Director of KLK at the official signing ceremony
Apart from continued training, Peng Soon and Liu Ying also taking natural supplements to help increase sport endurance
Peng Soon and Liu Ying are the first Brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement
Also featured in The Star and Ipoh Echo.

caption:
KLK OLEO announces today the appointment of Ralf Ewering as Chief Sustainability Officer Europe.
Ralf will drive and lead the development and delivery of the Europe region’s sustainability strategy to further establish KLK OLEO’s sustainability leadership in the Oleochemical industry.
“I’m excited to further drive momentum to KLK OLEO’s sustainability journey and work on the positive transition of our industry towards the people and our planet.” Ralf Ewering said.
Ralf has 27 years of experience in different managerial positions in the process industry and is working for 17 years in the oleochemical industry. Ralf holds a Master in Chemical Engineering from the Technical University of Dortmund.
At KLK OLEO, our principles on sustainability are guided by integrity. Sustainability is fundamental to how we conduct our business and we have a robust structure in place to facilitate the implementation of sustainability strategies across the Group. Our commitment to ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) and Sustainability Policy enable KLK OLEO continues to grow as the most trusted partner in sustainable products and solutions.
About KLK OLEO
Built on a legacy of integrity, humility, innovation and loyalty, KLK OLEO is committed to providing the best sustainable solutions to address global demands and consumer trends. As a worldwide oleochemical producer with over 100 years of experience, KLK OLEO’s products can be found in most consumer staples, from Beauty & Personal Care, Food & Health Care, Home Care, Industries & Institutional Cleaning, Lubricants to Polymers.
KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KUALA LUMPUR KEPONG BERHAD (KLK). A leading international Plantations group listed on the Main Board of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.

caption:
KLK has once again been recognised as one of Malaysia’s Best Managed Companies in 2024. This marks the third consecutive year we have received this honour, reflecting our Company’s organisational success and contributions to the industry. The awards ceremony took place on 22 August, at Le Meridien Kuala Lumpur.
This year was particularly special, as KLK’s Executive Chairman, Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian was invited to be a guest speaker to share his insights on “Empowering the Next Generation for Business.”
Tan Sri Lee paid tribute to his father, the late Founder Chairman Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng, during his speech. He shared his experience as a second-generation leader and how he continued to build upon his father’s legacy. Additionally, he highlighted Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng’s subtle yet impactful mentorship and shared three valuable lessons:

 Core Values: “Integrity, humility, loyalty.” Values that Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng lived by, which continue to guide KLK’s dominant culture of T.H.R.I.I.L.
 Purpose in life: Finding fulfilment in life goes beyond wealth. It’s about creating a compassionate environment that impacts KLK’s 50,000 employees and their families. Balancing work and family: His ability to manage the demands of running a business while fostering family unity and solidarity.

 
KLK’s COO, Mr. Lee Jia Zhang, accepted the award on behalf of KLK. Ms. Lee Wen Ling, Managing Director of KLK Land, was also invited onstage to answer a few questions about the win.
When asked about the perception of the plantation industry as being part of the “old economy,” Ms. Lee responded: “I believe this view is inaccurate. As consumers become more conscious, there is a growing demand for sustainably produced products. To stay ahead, we must continue exploring and adapting, going beyond sustainability certifications to focus on areas like decarbonisation and traceability, among others.”

caption:
Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK” or the “Group”) is proud to announce the renewal of our sponsorship for Malaysia’s national badminton mixed doubles pair, Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai, through 2025. This renewal reflects KLK’s continued commitment to support local sporting talent and fostering national pride.
Since 2023, KLK has been a proud supporter of the pair, who have made remarkable strides on the international stage. In addition to renewing their sponsorship, KLK has extended support to their coach, Teo Kok Siang, ensuring the team has the resources to excel in the coming year.
As part of this partnership, Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai will also serve as KLK Brand Ambassadors for DavosLife Science products, including DavosLife E3 Complete Tocotrienols and Revive Skin Care BeauE Collagen.
Commenting on the partnership, KLK Chief Operating Officer, Lee Jia Zhang said, “We are incredibly proud of Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai for their dedication and outstanding performance over the past year. Their perseverance and sportsmanship are inspiring and we wish them the very best as they compete in the upcoming PETRONAS Malaysia Open and the 2025 season.”
Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai expressed their heartfelt gratitude for KLK’s continued support, saying “Our journey as independent players has been challenging, yet incredibly rewarding. Securing funding and meeting our tournament commitments has been a significant hurdle. KLK’s unwavering trust in our potential, regardless of outcomes, has been empowering. This partnership has not only boosted our confidence but has also provided us the stability to focus on our performance and represent Malaysia with pride.”
Looking ahead, the duo shared their ambitious goals: “Our immediate target for the PETRONAS Malaysia Open is to advance to the quarterfinals. Beyond that, we aim to refine our performance, maintain consistency and break into the world’s top five rankings. In 2024, we came close to securing a Super 1000 championship title in China but narrowly missed it. For 2025 we are motivated to achieve that milestone.”
KLK looks forward to celebrate more milestones with Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai as they continue to thrive and make Malaysia proud in the 2025 season.

caption:
For a full century, the site along the Langestraat has been a familiar landmark for anyone passing through this corner of Twente. The chimney that once bore the name Servo is long gone, but the chemical company behind it, today known as KLK Kolb Specialties B.V., part of KLK OLEO Surfactants, remains deeply woven into the fabric of the region. A centenary worth celebrating.
The seven-hectare site is a world of its own. Laboratories, research facilities and towering reactors holding tens of thousands of litres operate virtually without pause, the only exception being public holidays. Visitors quickly learn the rules: beyond a clearly marked yellow line, only specially approved mobile phones are permitted. Safety is non-negotiable in this industry.
From Delden into Every Home
The plant does not manufacture finished consumer products. Instead, it produces surfactants, which are surface-active agents that allow oil and water to mix, or make substances soluble that would otherwise refuse to dissolve. These chemical building blocks end up in shampoos, laundry detergents, wall paints and textiles. In other words, there is a good chance something made in Delden is sitting in your home right now.
From a Steam Laundry to a Global Group
The story begins in 1926, when two local entrepreneurs, Kuiper and Rozenbroek, set up shop in a disused steam laundry after their original plan to build in Enschede fell through. They served the Twente textile industry, and during the Second World War even pivoted to food production when circumstances demanded it.
Decades of growth, restructuring and ownership changes followed. Locally the site is still affectionately called Servo, even though that name was officially retired in 2000 and the iconic chimney demolished in 2018. Today the company is owned by Swiss-based Kolb Distribution Ltd., itself part of KLK OLEO, the oleochemical arm of Malaysian conglomerate Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad.
More Than Just a Factory
The site is unusually well-equipped for an industrial location. It has its own volunteer fire brigade, a dedicated wastewater treatment plant, and most remarkably, a private railway spur that branches off the Zutphen–Oldenzaal line and runs directly onto the premises. Freight trains have used this connection for decades to deliver raw materials straight to the factory floor.
The railway has not always run without incident. In the early 1980s a wrongly set switch accidentally directed a passenger train onto the site. It was stopped in time, nobody was hurt, and the story has since become part of company folklore.
Three Generations, Fifty-Year Careers
Walk through the site with a long-serving colleague and you quickly sense that this is more than just a workplace. Over 200 people are employed here, the vast majority from Delden and the wider Twente area, with many of them cycling in each morning. Staff turnover is remarkably low: three employees recently marked 40 years of service, and last year one colleague reached 50. There are families where three generations have worked on the same site, and farmers’ sons who once looked for a temporary job and never left. That kind of loyalty speaks for itself.
Centenary Celebrations
The anniversary programme ran across several days. A business reception took place on Thursday 30 April, followed on Friday 1 May by a gathering for retirees and former staff, with dignitaries including the mayor, a provincial executive and the Count of Twickel in attendance, and an evening party for current employees.
On Saturday 2 May, the site opened its doors to the general public. As production continues around the clock and safety rules are strict, visitors were guided around the grounds by bus. The programme included live demonstrations by the company fire brigade and a kids’ science lab.
From a small chemical supplier for the local textile industry to a global player in specialty chemistry; one hundred years of growth, resilience and community. The story of KLK Kolb Specialties is far from over, and the next hundred years have already begun.
